activity_summary: At the lodging you put the afternoon into one decision. What they cannot out-bellow they will have to out-write. The line quieted the room even when it was mocked. Berowne stays under your arm. You did not read him to Richard, and you will not tonight.

facets.activity: Said the bellowing would have to be out-written

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: What they cannot out-bellow they will have to out-write.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Berowne stays under the arm. Not for Richard. Not tonight.
